It stays below about 0.75 (mostly at the 0.47 floor on '.') on short plain narration of everyday household actions built from very common words (opened the door, picked up his bag, made a cup of tea, dried his face), on HTML tags and CSS/code keywords with no numeric literal, and when the trigger is swapped for a non-trigger ('a different story', 'room B', '2002-present', 'said we left').
